channel.title: Actuent changelog
channel.description: What's new in Actuent, the search engine for AI agents.

item.title: Events, price alerts, cheapest shop and AI bot visits
item.description:
• actuent_events: upcoming events (concerts, classes, workshops) that websites publish, by city, dates and topic.
  • actuent_watch_price (Pro): get an email or webhook when a product's price drops.
  • Products sold by several shops appear once, at the cheapest shop, with other_shops, matched by barcode or name.
  • Business details include star ratings and services or menu items with prices.
  • actuent_nearby also returns businesses from Actuent's index near you, with their rating, services and opening hours.
  • Booking and ordering systems (OpenTable, Calendly, Fresha, Booksy, Wolt and more) become direct links on book and order actions.
  • Actuent reads sites' llms.txt; the WordPress plugin (1.2.0) and Cloudflare Worker (1.1.0) now publish one.
  • AI bot visits (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot…) in Analytics → My sites, reported by the WordPress plugin or Cloudflare Worker.
  • Site pages show how to improve the agent-readiness score, with a starter lawp.json and schema.org snippet.
  • Weekly score email for claimed sites, with the most valuable next step.
  • The LAWP Generator: make a lawp.json in your browser.
  • MCP prompts (plan_night_out, find_best_deal, book_appointment, whats_on, check_site) and resources.
  • The leaderboard at api.actuent.ai/leaderboard works again.

item.title: Business details, open now, price changes and site pages
item.description:
• Search results include business details from a site's schema.org data: address, phone, opening hours and price range, plus open_now.
  • actuent_nearby shows opening hours for each place and takes an open_now filter.
  • Products show price changes: previous_price_eur and price_change_percent when a price moved.
  • LAWP 0.3: actions can describe their input as named fields (date, time, email, …). Actuent validates the input before calling the site and returns each action's JSON Schema in actuent_get_actions.
  • Every indexed site has a public page at api.actuent.ai/site/<domain> with its readiness score, actions and business details.
  • The badge at api.actuent.ai/badge.svg?domain= shows a live agent-readiness score out of 100.
  • Social preview images for Actuent pages.
  • Owners get a welcome email when they claim a site.
  • The crawler finds subpages from each site's sitemap and uses more free AI providers.
  • Security headers on every Actuent site, plus Dependabot and CodeQL on the public repositories.
  • WordPress plugin 1.1.0: the contact action asks for name, email and message.

item.title: Rule-based conversion and a faster backlog
item.description:
• Sites are converted to LAWP without an LLM when the free quota is used up, so fewer sites stay minimal.
  • Infrastructure hostnames (CDNs, DNS servers) are skipped instead of indexed.
  • New sites are paused until every existing minimal entry has been retried once.

item.title: Products, any-language search and site claiming
item.description:
• Shopping searches return products with prices from Shopify and WooCommerce shops, with budgets like under €100 in any currency.
  • Search in any language; results always come back in English.
  • Claim your site in Analytics → My sites and edit its pages and actions without code.
  • OpenAPI description at api.actuent.ai/openapi.json, a Python SDK and LangChain/LlamaIndex tools.
  • Rate-limit headers on every response, hashed API keys, usage and delete-my-data in Analytics.
  • Referrals: a free month of Pro for every friend who subscribes.
  • WordPress plugin and a one-click Cloudflare Worker for publishing native LAWP.

item.title: Executable actions and sign-in for ChatGPT and Claude
item.description:
• actuent_execute_action really performs actions on sites that publish LAWP action endpoints.
  • Action requests are signed with Ed25519, with a test mode and a LAWP Checker in the docs.
  • OAuth 2.1 sign-in so Pro works in ChatGPT and Claude connectors.
  • Priority access for Pro and semantic query expansion.
  • Actuent Bot identifies itself and respects robots.txt.

item.title: Vector search and webhooks
item.description:
• Vector search, webhooks for site changes and a suggest-a-site form.
  • LAWP score contributes to search ranking.

item.title: Rate limits and multi-language LAWP
item.description:
• Rate limits: 20 requests/minute free, 60 for Pro.
  • Sites in other languages are translated; a health endpoint for status monitoring.

item.title: All MCP tools
item.description:
• News, nearby, trending, compare, execute, history and summarise tools.
  • LAWP score and change tracking (diffs).

item.title: Badges and native LAWP
item.description: • /.well-known/lawp.json support, the Actuent badge and a live stats API.

item.title: Live crawling and full-text search
item.description:
• Any site is crawled live the first time it's searched and saved to the index.
  • Keyword search across every indexed site, including individual pages.

item.title: First release
item.description: • The Actuent MCP server with free and Pro tiers, the @actuent/sdk register endpoint and the docs site.
